scope: 14 downloaded model items plus 6 freshly inspected candidates

candidates.baseline: PGM.forward concatenates x baseline with adapted chemical context
candidates.dose: Native fingerprint scaling by log10(dose+1); keep dose explicit in request
candidates.morgan_interface: Linear(2048,1024) before native CombAdaptor; scale adapted fingerprint by native dose rule
candidates.decision: Preferred pilot. Configurable x_dim controls encoder input and full mean/variance output; no 978 checkpoint reuse.

candidates.baseline: Native encoder consumes expression before perturbation shift
candidates.dose: GeneralizedSigmoid supports raw-dose fallback; default learned per-drug dosers need cold-drug scrutiny
candidates.morgan_interface: PerturbationNetwork accepts external drug_embeddings plus native nn.Linear projection
candidates.decision: Source-compatible RDKit path. Select and disclose a native dose configuration without fitting held-out drug-specific response parameters.

candidates.dose: Native amortized doser consumes drug embedding and dose; avoids unseen-drug learned doser table
candidates.morgan_interface: Existing fixed-embedding interface plus trainable embedding encoder; replace common chemistry projection with joint Linear
candidates.decision: Source-compatible; retain Gaussian reconstruction plus native adversary objectives/alternation and validate author loss selection.

candidates.dose: RDKitEmbedding appends log dose parsed from condition; preserve actual floating dose rather than int truncation
candidates.morgan_interface: Continuous RDKit condition representation before native conditional network; train Linear jointly in JAX transport params
candidates.decision: Source-compatible continuous conditional transport. Published reduced-space setup is not proof of 18164-gene Sinkhorn/transport feasibility.

candidates.baseline: Unknown latent comes from sample_indices lookup; ordered networks consume attributes, not baseline vector
candidates.morgan_interface: Chemical ordered attributes exist, but do not fix baseline input
candidates.decision: No native expression encoder for a new approved same-plate baseline. Adding one would change core architecture; observation latents are not baseline participation.

candidates.morgan_interface: not reevaluated
candidates.decision: Explicit user exclusion in ADR0042; historical results preserved. This is not an inferred architecture/resource failure.

candidates.decision: Explicit user exclusion in ADR0042; historical results preserved. This is not an inferred architecture/resource failure.

candidates.morgan_interface: No chemical representation interface
candidates.decision: Native prediction transports the learned shift of an observed treatment; no structure-based new-drug input.

candidates.baseline: forward_view consumes both treated and control bags
candidates.morgan_interface: No chemical-only new-drug predictor in released mechanism model
candidates.decision: Released forward_view requires treated expression to infer mechanism representation; cannot expose test-treated bag for prediction.

candidates.publication: Formal publication gate not needed after interface failure
candidates.dose: Absent from forward and native train call
candidates.morgan_interface: Fingerprint path exists
candidates.decision: No explicit native dose conditioning. Creating dose branch is outside allowed adapter-only modification.

candidates.publication: Published paper referenced by source README
candidates.dose: Absent from forward and dataset drug-feature interface
candidates.morgan_interface: Continuous chemical feature interface exists
candidates.decision: No native dose-conditioning path; dose cannot be silently ignored or invented.

candidates.publication: Pinned README refers to preprint; current publication not a necessary gate after chemical failure
candidates.morgan_interface: Pinned transition path uses categorical perturbation identity
candidates.decision: Pinned model has no verified native structure-derived cold-drug interface; adding a chemistry backbone is not the agreed adapter.

candidates.baseline: Native CellContextEncoder basal projector exists and n_genes is configurable
candidates.morgan_interface: Chemical encoder is ChemBERTa with LoRA; boundary replacement/fidelity not verified
candidates.decision: Do not inherit old 978-only exclusion: dimension changes are allowed. Need confirm joint Morgan adapter at existing representation boundary while preserving core operator, objective on expression/delta rather than L1000 z-scores, native setup, and full-axis runtime.

candidates.dose: No dose input in FNN forward
candidates.morgan_interface: Precomputed 768-dimensional MPG vectors
candidates.decision: No explicit dose-conditioning input; 978-specific layer shapes also require changes. Formal publication and baseline input do not remedy missing native dose.

candidates.dose: CovEncoder chemberta_cls path contains separate dose index embedding
candidates.morgan_interface: Frozen chemical embedding followed by nn.Linear; use common Morgan and jointly trained linear at this boundary
candidates.decision: Source-compatible candidate; needs ADR0030 source acquisition, native setup/environment and full-axis runtime. 12626-gene config alone is insufficient. Categorical doses are permissible metadata when shared with training; no test responses.

candidates.baseline: Control branch is present in Model.forward
candidates.dose: No explicit native dose path in inspected run/config/embedding files
candidates.morgan_interface: Model has continuous perturbation vector but native PerturbationEmbedding is categorical lookup
candidates.decision: Official repo says ICLR2026, OpenReview browser challenge prevents direct venue verification. Need verify native dose and chemical conditioning without new architecture before setup/full-axis runtime; do not admit from continuous vector signature alone.

candidates.baseline: Paper claims cell-specific attributes; exact input contract not verified
candidates.morgan_interface: Paper claims drug molecular features; code interface not verified
candidates.decision: New relevant Biomni hit. Bounded exact-title/model-name primary search found formal article but no verified public model/train/test repository. Cannot admit without code, license, interface, environment and runtime evidence.

candidates.morgan_interface: Embedding path not verified
candidates.decision: Official README still points to preprint; formal venue and native chemical/dose interfaces unverified. Do not declare a preprint formally published.

candidates.baseline: Paper encodes control cells with pretrained State SE-600M
candidates.morgan_interface: Knowledge-pretrained molecular encoder
candidates.decision: Published pipeline depends on external pretrained cell/molecular representations, outside random-init/no-independent-pretraining contract; removing them is unverified core-method change.
